title: Salinas (London) and Ronquillo (Nijmegen) to Fuenmayor, 1676-78, DECODE R966-R984, R1001

steps.what: Applied the Balbases key to all 20 remaining SEG 2559 cipher records.
Six records typed with no group boundaries read 0%; rejoined and segmented by DP over the key vocabulary.
Mapped DECODE's 'Infinity' sign in R970/R973 to c+vowel.
Key output agrees with the 16 marginal decipherments; four unmargined letters read in gist.

Checked the old measure: read.py counts groups found in the key (nulls and nonsense values included), so 0.88 is key coverage, not sense. Wrote sense.py (DP segmentation into Spanish words from lang/ es-gutenberg, es-quijote, es-vasto-memorias plus the volume's margins; a group is read only if all its letters fall in words). DECODE transcription + old key: 89.0% in key, 76.9% sense.
Re-fetched DECODE transcriptions and images (cookie); mktx.py drops in-group '?' uncertainty marks and header lines parsed as cipher.
Added the hernannunez1674 image-checked values (bof, cuf, 187, 149, 111, cin, cel, on, 69, 32, 13=e, N=V.S.).

Hard-EM alignment (em.py) of the 16 margined letters against their margin decipherments: 5=a, 17=o, 33=u, r=y, C+=ll, xoy=con, 144=ion, 83=or, M_=V.S. Sense 76.9% -> 81.1%. Other frequent unknowns (1+3+, r+, c, 2, W, b, 25bd) aligned mostly to nothing (nulls or noise), left unvalued.
Image re-transcription of R982 (all 4 pages, txi/R982.txt; page 4 has no cipher): 813 -> 913 groups (DECODE omitted ~100), sense 55.2% -> 81.2%.

Applied R982's confusion list (96->46, 92->42, 00->xo, fire->d+, 2/3->7 in unread digit groups, 30->70) to the other 19 DECODE transcriptions: 96/92/00 never occur there, fire 5 times, 30->70 changes nothing; only 2/3->7 helps. Total sense 82.0% -> 82.4%. The confusions are R982-transcriber specific.

outcome.method_basis: All twenty letters in Fuenmayor's volume (AGR SEG 2559) were read unchanged with the Balbases 1677 key, which the project had rebuilt earlier for other letters in the same volume; sixteen carry contemporary marginal decipherments that agree with the output.
outcome.fraction_read_source: dec2.py + sense.py, 5 Oct 2026: 23,561 groups, 93.0% in key, 82.4% read as sense (groups whose letters all fall inside Spanish words); the earlier 0.88 counted key coverage only
outcome.notes: Read in part: 0.824 of groups read as sense (sense.py); the earlier 0.88 was key coverage. Image re-transcription in progress.

gaps.item: 17.6% of groups not read as sense (sense.py, 5 Oct 2026)
gaps.detail: mostly DECODE transcription noise; images being re-transcribed into txi/ letter by letter (R982 done, R976 running)

credits.note: marginal decipherments on 16 of the 20 letters, which confirm the key output

prior.where: Marginal decipherments on 16 of 20 letters; sibling key rebuilt in this project

human: Supplied the DECODE cookie; asked to try the Balbases key on the rest of the volume.
